cases.title: Approved earnings aggregate into one payment per employee
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Exactly three payments total NGN435,000. Amara receives one NGN150,000 payment. Every payment notification is sent.

cases.title: Opening Monday midnight is included
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: The opening-boundary earning is included; recorded pay is NGN150,000.

cases.title: Following Monday midnight belongs to the next period
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: The first run pays NGN40,000 from start + last only. The NGN40,000 closing-boundary earning is paid in the next period; two payment records exist across both periods.

cases.title: Lagos offset is normalized before period selection
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Only inside qualifies. outside normalizes to the preceding Sunday; inside normalizes to opening Monday midnight. Total recorded pay is NGN150,000.

cases.title: Reimporting an identical earning never increases pay
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: One earning record remains; one payment records NGN150,000.

cases.title: Conflicting duplicate rolls back the entire import
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: HTTP 409. The new record is rolled back and the original earning remains unchanged; the list still has one earning.

cases.title: Pending approval blocks payment and leaves the period open
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: HTTP 409. The period remains open; no payment or notification exists.

cases.title: Failed payment creates no notification and can be retried
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: First attempt: zero payment, zero notification and zero provider acceptance. Retry: one NGN150,000 payment.

cases.title: Notification failure preserves the successful payment
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: The NGN150,000 payment remains recorded. One notification is pending, no provider acceptance exists, and payment_committed occurs before notification_attempted.

cases.title: Retrying after notification failure preserves the approved payroll

cases.title: Notification-only recovery never changes payment identity
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Payment objects remain unchanged, pending notification count becomes zero, and provider acceptance is exactly one.

cases.title: A processed period rejects new earnings and preserves approved totals
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Import returns HTTP 409. Approved and recorded payroll remain NGN150,000.

cases.title: The same employee can receive a separate payment in another period
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Next-period recorded pay is NGN50,000. Two pay runs and two employee-period payment records exist.

cases.title: Invalid dates and ambiguous timestamps are rejected
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Every invalid request returns HTTP 400.

cases.title: Amounts use positive bounded whole kobo
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Invalid imports return HTTP 400. One kobo is accepted and pays NGN0.01.

cases.title: Unknown employees cannot acquire earnings or payments
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Unknown-employee import returns HTTP 400; empty approved payroll returns HTTP 409.

cases.title: Isolated workspaces do not share earnings or payment identity
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: A does not alter B. B can independently record its own NGN150,000 payment.

cases.title: Approval is explicit and replaying approval is harmless
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Approval replay is harmless; rejected approval returns HTTP 409. Only earn-001 contributes; total is NGN150,000.

cases.title: Record, approve and process earnings through the interface
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: The confirmation and resulting ledger both use NGN150,000.25.

cases.title: Cancelling payroll confirmation leaves the ledger and period unchanged
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Dialog closes, focus returns to its trigger, the period stays open and no payment is created.

cases.title: Receipt survives reload and can be copied and downloaded
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Receipt reference remains visible and unchanged. Clipboard contains that reference; downloaded receipt names Amara Okafor.

cases.title: Payment filter and CSV export contain the same employee records
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: One record is shown. Export contains Daniel and 200000.00, and excludes Amara.

cases.title: Changing pay period separates approval and payment totals
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Next-period label is 12–18 October 2026, recorded pay is NGN0.00, and one approval is pending.

cases.title: Core screens reflow at 320 pixels without page overflow
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: No route has horizontal page overflow; Pay runs navigation remains in the viewport.

cases.title: Keyboard navigation reaches content and payroll confirmation
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Skip link focuses main; route change focuses the page title; Cancel is first, Process payroll follows, and Escape restores trigger focus.

cases.title: Employee details lead to the correct earning destination
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Daniel details and destination are correct; the earning form preselects emp-002.

cases.title: Payroll screens use product language and show standard totals
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Overview shows Payroll overview and NGN435,000. No old banking, WebMCP or assessment labels appear in its rendered body.

cases.title: Notification recovery is visible and leaves the receipt unchanged
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: The payment is unchanged, pending count is zero and the completed recovery action is disabled.

cases.title: Separate tabs retain their workspace and pay period after reload
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: A keeps its own date and workspace. A shows NGN150,000 for its original period; B independently retains NGN435,000 and 13 October.

cases.title: Served build matches its package and cannot switch implementation
cases.actual: Automated assertions passed: Served build ID and source fingerprint match the selected folder; policy-switch request returns HTTP 400.
